snip.t: Heavy drinking, poor sleep, isolation and ruminative thinking are now maintaining and worsening her depression and raising her suicide risk.
Depression is the dominant, most disabling pole in bipolar disorder, with a high suicide risk.
The depressive burden, suicide risk and functional impairment are equal to or greater than bipolar I.

Plan from the formulation: assess and manage suicide risk; antidepressant and/or CBT for the depression; reduce alcohol; treat insomnia; involve the friend and family; academic support (deferral, counselling); follow-up.
Main indication: long-term prophylaxis of bipolar disorder and treatment of acute mania (it also reduces suicide risk).
